This Form 4/A amends the Form 4 filed on August 3, 2026, solely to correct the grant date of the restricted stock units reported herein from July 31, 2026, to July 30, 2026. || Represents a grant of Performance Stock Units ("PSUs") under the SoundHound AI, Inc. 2022 Incentive Award Plan. Each PSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of Class A Common Stock. The PSUs will satisfy the performance-based vesting condition if the closing sales price of the Company's Common Stock reaches certain levels during the performance window ending July 30, 2029.
